description: This file defines classes and methods for handling datetime operations within pandas-on-Spark, including subtraction, comparison, and type casting for timestamp types.

classes.name: DatetimeOps
classes.description: Handles binary operations and type conversions for pandas-on-Spark objects with TimestampType.

classes.name: DatetimeNTZOps
classes.description: Handles binary operations and type conversions for pandas-on-Spark objects with TimestampNTZType.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Performs subtraction between datetime-like pandas-on-Spark objects, with special handling for timestamp types.

methods.name: rsub
methods.description: Performs reverse subtraction for datetime-like objects.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Less-than or equal comparison between datetime objects.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Greater-than or equal comparison between datetime objects.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares a pandas Series for internal use, typically returning it unchanged.

methods.name: astype
methods.description: Casts pandas-on-Spark datetime objects to different data types, including categorical, string, or numeric types.

methods.name: _cast_spark_column_timestamp_to_long
methods.description: Converts a Spark timestamp column to a long integer representing epoch time.
